summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The State Street SPDR S&P 1500 Momentum Tilt ETF (MMTM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 1500 Positive Momentum Tilt index. The fund tracks a tiered index that weights securities from the S&P 1500 according to a combination of their market capitalization and their price momentum over the previous 12 months. MMTM was launched on Oct 24, 2012 and is issued by State Street.

holdings.infoBox: MMTM is an equity ETF with a total of 1475 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 9.68%, Alphabet at 8.98%, NVIDIA at 6.03%, Micron Technology at 3.37%, and Broadcom at 2.78%.
